source: Codex runtime tool inventory: 38 connected apps, 355 app tools; local skill inventory reviewed separately.
principles: One primary oracle, then at most one independent corroborator when the claim is consequential, contested, or time-sensitive.
Local logs, tests, service status, and reproducible artifacts outrank all external plugin output.
External memory and write-capable applications are sources or executors, not automatic durable memory.

routes.output: dated facts with direct source URLs
cited research memo separated into facts, reports, and hypotheses
claim map with source provenance, causal uncertainty, and dated corroboration
primary paper records and scope-aware evidence
reproduction, failure class, evidence, and checked remediation
model or dataset metadata plus local serving/evaluation constraints
clearly scoped formal result and an explicit implementation-conformance check

capabilities.use_for: fresh, verified current facts and research direction
capabilities.limits: not a substitute for direct source review on high-stakes claims
search ranking is not evidence quality
use only when an independent search path is justified

capabilities.use_for: site maps, crawling, and source extraction
capabilities.limits: do not crawl broadly without a bounded question

capabilities.use_for: claim checking, causality, evidence, timelines, and prediction claims
capabilities.limits: a graph of claims is not proof of causation

capabilities.use_for: peer-reviewed paper discovery and paper records
capabilities.limits: fetch a returned paper record before citing it
distinguish retrieved passages from paper-wide conclusions

capabilities.use_for: academic comparison, open-access retrieval, and research knowledge-base work
capabilities.limits: do not make a second persistent knowledge base the Theseus memory source

capabilities.use_for: model, dataset, paper, Space, and evaluation discovery
capabilities.limits: metadata does not prove local hardware compatibility

capabilities.use_for: local AMD model serving and evaluation paths
capabilities.limits: use installed skill instructions; do not assume GPU support

capabilities.use_for: time-travel browser/runtime debugging when a recording exists
capabilities.limits: requires a recording; local logs remain the primary evidence

capabilities.use_for: discovering existing MCP servers before reinventing a bridge
capabilities.limits: registry listing is discovery, not trust approval
proves a formal model, not the running system

capabilities.use_for: external graph rendering and topic exploration
capabilities.limits: Graphify, AutoMem, and MemPalace retain local graph authority

capabilities.use_for: reproducible remote notebooks and shared data workflows
capabilities.limits: create or run only with an explicit project and owner intent

capabilities.plugin: Error Log Parser, Requirements Extractor, Payload Completeness Checker, API Response Cleaner
capabilities.use_for: narrow structured parsing and payload readiness checks
capabilities.limits: use only for matching structured inputs; they are not general reasoning engines

capabilities.use_for: user-owned source retrieval and deliberate synchronization
capabilities.limits: not automatic durable memory; writes require explicit user intent

capabilities.use_for: durable decisions, episodic recall, and verified continuity
capabilities.limits: do not duplicate raw external transcripts

deferred_or_excluded.reason: Third persistent memory store; keep outside the automatic Theseus write path to avoid split-brain memory.

deferred_or_excluded.plugin: Gmail, Todoist, ButlerBrain write tools, Google Drive write tools
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Write-capable personal systems require explicit owner intent.

deferred_or_excluded.plugin: BioRender, Mermaid Chart, documents, presentations, spreadsheets
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Output and visualization tools, not advisors; invoke only for a requested artifact.

deferred_or_excluded.plugin: FindIp, smarts.bio, life-science-research, DataCamp, Midpage Legal Research, Metaplay SDK Docs
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Domain-specific routes; keep discoverable but do not pull into general engineering or research conclaves.

deferred_or_excluded.plugin: Mnemom, MarcoPolo, OpenAI Developers key-management tools, Sites, plugin management
deferred_or_excluded.reason: Access, deployment, or external-workspace tools; use only with a concrete task and its native safety procedure.
